name: Lidl
verdict: Lidl is a division of the privately held Schwarz Group, owned by Dieter Schwarz via a foundation. Nothing found.
note: German discount supermarket chain; majority owner of the Lidl-Trek team (Cyclingnews, 2025-12-11). Rated none: the ownership chain (Lidl - Schwarz Group - Dieter Schwarz) carries no state stake and no human-rights finding against Lidl or Schwarz Group was found in this run.
